detailZones.title: Check-in counter row shell
detailZones.description: Trace the visible counter worktops, privacy panels, drawers, bases, ledges and cable covers.

detailZones.title: Staffed desk equipment
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible document, boarding-pass, baggage-tag and receipt equipment on the desks.

detailZones.title: Baggage scale and conveyor
detailZones.description: Follow the visible luggage scale, belt, rollers, side guides, chute and bag-drop hardware.

detailZones.title: Self-service kiosk bank
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible kiosk screens, readers, printers, panels, bases, plates and cable covers.

detailZones.title: Overhead display wall
detailZones.description: Study the blank display panels, mounting arms, wall cladding, glazing and ceiling fittings.

detailZones.title: Queue and accessible lane
detailZones.description: Trace the visible stanchions, belts, lane dividers, accessible opening and floor guidance.

detailZones.title: Floor and baggage ancillaries
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible floor finish, paper and tag supplies, bins, lower panels and access plates.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 check-in-counter photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 153 independently pointable counter, document, baggage, kiosk, display, queue and floor parts. Passenger identity, airline branding, readable screens, prices, baggage status, check-in outcomes and hidden airport systems were excluded.
